product_metadata.title: Romingo a Pair of Black Angel Christmas Decorations Light with Sparkling Multicolored Lights and Timer for Christmas Decoration-Black
features: 🎄ANGEL DECORATIONS: Made of resin+crylic, there is a string light inside the Christmas tree. Eye-catching sparkling detailed home, office decor, decoration
🎄UNIQUE GIFT IDEA: Give this as a Christmas gift to mom, grandma, sister, aunt, and or friends. It can also be used as a memorial gift to remember a special friend or family member.
🎄DECORATIVE USES: Makes a great accessory for any occasion decor application. Give as a gift or display as a tabletop centerpiece, on a fireplace mantel, shelf, or window decoration.
🎄FINE DESIGN: detailed figurine, and great collectible decor for Living room, Bedroom, Office Decoration.

🎄DIMENSION: 5.9 Inches Height and 4.5 Inches Width. Battery-powered ( 3 AAA batteries are required but not included) dual operated to light up with a 6 hours timer function. After six hours, it will be turned off for 18 hours.
